spreads.title: Past - Present - Future
spreads.description: Provides insight into past influences, the current situation, and the future.

positions.title: Past
positions.meaning: What past events or influences are still affecting my current situation?

positions.title: Present
positions.meaning: What is shaping my life or this situation right now?

positions.title: Future
positions.meaning: What is the most likely outcome if nothing changes?

spreads.title: Mind - Heart - Soul
spreads.description: Aligns the mind, emotions, and spirit to help you make better decisions.

positions.title: Mind
positions.meaning: What is the main thought or logical approach occupying my mind right now?

positions.title: Heart
positions.meaning: What are my true feelings and inner desires regarding this situation?

positions.title: Soul
positions.meaning: What guidance is my higher self or soul offering me in this matter?

spreads.title: Problem - Action - Avoid
spreads.description: Identifies the core issue, the best action to take, and what you need to avoid.

positions.title: Problem
positions.meaning: What is the root cause or hidden aspect of the problem I am facing?

positions.title: Action
positions.meaning: What is the most active and correct step I should take to solve this issue?

positions.title: Avoid
positions.meaning: What behavior or action must I absolutely avoid to prevent making things worse?

spreads.title: Stop - Start - Continue
spreads.description: Improves your habits by identifying what to stop, what to start, and what to maintain.

positions.title: Stop
positions.meaning: What harmful or limiting habit should I let go of?

positions.title: Start
positions.meaning: What new action should I initiate to add value to my life and raise my energy?

positions.title: Continue
positions.meaning: What am I doing right currently that I need to maintain and build upon?

spreads.title: Morning - Afternoon - Night
spreads.description: Provides daily guidance to help you plan your day and manage your energy.

positions.title: Morning
positions.meaning: What main energy or action should I focus on as I start my day?

positions.title: Afternoon
positions.meaning: What challenge or opportunity might I encounter in the middle of the day?

positions.title: Night
positions.meaning: What should I release or celebrate as I close out the day?
